title.purpose: Section headings, dialog titles, the brand name.

subtitle.purpose: Chart titles, rule headings, large counts in the status filter.

body.purpose: Running text and table values; tabular figures.

label.purpose: Table headers, segmented options, pills, form labels.

caption.purpose: Hints, counts, chart axis and legend text; the minimum size.

vehicle-number.purpose: The vehicle id in tables, set like a fleet number.

shadows.name: float

motion.name: sheet-in

breakpoints.name: md

breakpoints.name: coarse-pointer
breakpoints.purpose: Touch screens: every control grows to 44 px (touch-target).

components.name: Link Button
components.css: .ds-btn-link { padding: 0; border: none; background: none; color: var(--route); font-family: var(--text, 'Barlow', system-ui, sans-serif); font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-link:hover { color: var(--route-strong); text-decoration: underline; } .ds-btn-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--route); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Segmented Toggle

components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; gap: 2px; padding: 2px; border: 1px solid var(--rule); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--paper); } .ds-seg-item { height: 26px; min-width: 30px; padding: 0 9px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; background: none; color: var(--ink-2); font-family: var(--display, 'Barlow Semi Condensed', 'Barlow', system-ui, sans-serif); font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-seg-item:hover { background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink); } .ds-seg-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--route); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-seg-item.is-on { background: var(--route); color: var(--on-route); cursor: default; }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Every health verdict as colour, icon and word together; never colour alone.
components.html: Porucha Varování V pořádku
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 2px 9px 2px 6px; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: var(--text, 'Barlow', system-ui, sans-serif); font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-pill-fault { background: var(--fault-soft); color: var(--fault); } .ds-pill-warning { background: var(--warning-soft); color: var(--warning); } .ds-pill-ok { background: var(--ok-soft); color: var(--ok); }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: An active filter above the charts, removable.
components.html: Stav:Porucha
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; height: 30px; padding: 0 4px 0 10px; border: 1px solid var(--route); border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--route-soft); color: var(--ink); font-family: var(--text, 'Barlow', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 14px; } .ds-chip-label { color: var(--ink-2); } .ds-chip-x { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 24px; height: 24px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; background: none; color: var(--ink-2); cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip-x:hover { background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); } .ds-chip-x:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--route); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Screen Tabs
components.description: Header navigation between screens; the active one is underlined in petrol.
components.html: <nav class="ds-tabs" role="tablist"><button class="ds-tab" role="tab" aria-selected="false">Mapa sítě</button><button class="ds-tab is-active" role="tab" aria-selected="true">Stav jednotek</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 4px; height: 56px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); } .ds-tab { padding: 0 12px; border: none; border-bottom: 3px solid transparent; background: none; color: var(--ink-2); font-family: var(--text, 'Barlow', system-ui, sans-serif); font-weight: 500; font-size: 14px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab:hover { color: var(--ink); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--route); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-tab.is-active { border-bottom-color: var(--route); color: var(--ink); font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Chart Card
components.description: The frame every chart sits in: flat, hairline, title and subtitle.
components.css: .ds-card { margin: 0; padding: 16px 18px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--rule); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--paper); } .ds-card-title { margin: 0; font-family: var(--display, 'Barlow Semi Condensed', 'Barlow', system-ui, sans-serif); font-weight: 600; font-size: 17px; color: var(--ink); } .ds-card-sub { margin: 2px 0 10px; font-family: var(--text, 'Barlow', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 13px; color: var(--ink-2); } .ds-card-plot { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(6, 1fr); gap: 2px; height: 24px; } .ds-card-plot span { border-radius: 2px; } .ds-card-plot span:nth-child(1) { background: var(--seq-1); } .ds-card-plot span:nth-child(2) { background: var(--seq-2); } .ds-card-plot span:nth-child(3) { background: var(--seq-3); } .ds-card-plot span:nth-child(4) { background: var(--seq-4); } .ds-card-plot span:nth-child(5) { background: var(--seq-5); } .ds-card-plot span:nth-child(6) { background: var(--seq-6); }

narrative.overview:
AdaPlatform reads like printed public-transport matter: timetable ink on white paper, a signage face in two widths, and one colour, Route Petrol, drawn like the line on a network diagram. The page is a working document for an analyst, not a display: factual, calm and legible, with a lot of numbers held in a strict rhythm. Nothing competes for attention until something is wrong, and then the status colour says so, always with an icon and a word.

Density is high and deliberate. Tables, a fleet × day heatmap and small charts sit together on one screen at 14 px body text with tabular figures, because analysts compare values side by side. Order comes from hairline rules, one type scale and consistent card frames rather than from boxes, colour or size.

It must never look like a flashy BI tool: no walls of multicoloured charts, no decorative colour, no chart without a reason. Colour appears where it carries meaning (product navigation, status, magnitude on one sequential ramp) and nowhere else. Light and dark themes are designed as a pair; the map, whose tiles stay light, keeps its own fixed ink.
keyCharacteristics: Timetable ink on paper, Route Petrol for wayfinding, status colour only for status.
Barlow for reading, Barlow Semi Condensed for headings, labels and vehicle numbers.
Flat at rest; hairline rules divide; a single shadow lifts only what floats.
Dense, tabular, aligned figures; one type scale (ratio 1.2 from 14 px).
Every verdict pairs colour with an icon and a word.
A route line with stops as the product mark and the recurring motif.

rules.name: The Status Means Status Rule
rules.body: Fault, Warning, OK and Too-little-data colours are used only for a health verdict, never for a chart series, a decoration or a brand accent.

rules.name: The Petrol Is Wayfinding Rule
rules.body: Route Petrol marks where you are and what is selected. It never signals a status, good or bad.

rules.name: The Fixed Map Ink Rule
rules.body: Anything drawn on the map uses the map tokens, not the theme tokens; the tiles don't change with the theme.

rules.name: The Aligned Figures Rule
rules.body: Numbers are always tabular (`tnum`) and right-aligned in columns, so digits line up across rows.

rules.name: The Two Widths Rule
rules.body: Only Barlow and Barlow Semi Condensed; no third family, no monospace for data.

rules.name: The Flat-at-Rest Rule
rules.body: A card on the page gets a border, never a shadow. A shadow means "this is on top of the page".

dos: **Do** pair every status colour with its icon and word (Status pill), in tables, legends and filters alike.
**Do** keep Route Petrol for navigation, selection, primary actions and the route line.
**Do** use tabular, right-aligned figures in every column of numbers.
**Do** separate content with 1 px Rule borders and tone, and keep the Float shadow for things that float.
**Do** design both themes: every colour comes from a token with a light and a dark value; map overlays use the fixed map tokens.
**Do** keep the minimum text size at 12 px, and targets at 24 px (44 px on touch).
donts: **Don't** make it a flashy BI tool: no walls of multicoloured charts, no colour that carries no meaning.
**Don't** use a status colour for a chart series, a decoration or the brand.
**Don't** show a status by colour alone.
**Don't** put shadows on cards or other elements at rest on the page.
**Don't** introduce a third typeface or a monospace for data.
